Direction A, locked in. Desktop at 1440 and mobile at 390 carry the same sections in the same order — the mobile version drops the phone-mock frame (you are already on a phone) and stacks the Old Way / AI-Assisted Way panels.
Breakpoints for the Next.js build: 1440 → 1024 (same layout, tighter gutters) → 768 (two-column grids collapse to one) → 390.
Everything in [BRACKETS] is a real fact I don't have yet: session dates and times, the three testimonials, the Telegram channel link, and the company name + jurisdiction for the risk disclaimer.
